traceability.notes: Performance data extracted by claude-sonnet-5 reading the PDF directly (native document input), used as a fallback because the deterministic pdfplumber pipeline (summary_report_parser.py) found no per-category breakdown in this report. Model's own extraction notes: This report presents results for the method comparison study using Table 6 (confirmation a, minimum incubation time) as the primary/canonical data set, per the four ISO 16140-2 food categories tested (Raw Meat products, Raw vegetables, Raw milk and raw milk dairy products, Environmental samples). The report also provides three additional variants of the same comparison table: Table 6 with maximum incubation time, and Table 7 (confirmation b) with both minimum and maximum incubation times - these were not extracted but show similar values (SEalt/SEref/RT/FPR ranging roughly 78-100% across categories, summarized in Table 8: overall SEalt 84.0-89.1%, SEref 81.9-85.0%, RT 85.7-86.1%, FPR 1.3-4.4% depending on confirmation method/incubation time combination). The 'Total protocol' rows within Tables 6/7 (labeled with circled numbers 1-6) represent sub-protocols/matrices within each category (e.g., different meat types, cheese types) and were correctly excluded as they are not distinct ISO categories. A separate interlaboratory study (Table 26) reported aggregate SEalt=98.9%, SEref=99.4%, RT=98.3%, FPR=0.0% across 11 collaborators, but this was not broken down by food category so was not included in the per-category table. Certificate number was given as 'BIO 12/25–05/09' on the cover page alongside product reference 30122; no separate distinct 'certificate number' format (e.g. 'NF VALIDATION XX/XX-XX/XX') was found elsewhere in the visible text, so this code is used as the certificate identifier.
